plan.title: Annual Donation Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of total funds, donor distribution, and payment methods for the year

panels.title: Donations by Payment Mode
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 6

panels.title: Donations by City
panels.sql: SELECT "City", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Donors by Amount
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
This year, our organization received a total of {{p1}} in donations from {{p2}} unique individuals. The data highlights the diverse ways our supporters contribute, with various payment modes being utilized across the country.

When analyzing the sources of these funds, it is evident that certain cities have been more generous than others. The top contributing cities, ranked by total amount received, are detailed in the city breakdown panel, showing a strong presence from major urban centers.

Furthermore, the payment method analysis reveals the preferred channels for our donors. Whether through digital means like UPI and cards or traditional methods like cheques and cash, every contribution is vital. The top 10 donors by total amount are listed to recognize the significant impact of our most generous supporters.
